items.title: Polynomial conversion of noncommutative formulas into abecedarian formulas with logarithmically many buckets

items.difficulty_reason: The author balances noncommutative formulas while maintaining interval types, creates an interval-indexed abecedarian circuit, and controls the unfolding blowup by counting monotone endpoint paths when the bucket count is logarithmic.
